description: Makes a finished, editable design in the person’s Paletoo files from a professional template, in one call: posts, stories, post + story, carousels, YouTube thumbnails, business cards, invitations, menus, posters. Picks a layout for the purpose, puts the person’s words in by role, hides every template sample fact the person did not give (never invent dates, prices, addresses or names) and finds a photo by meaning — or reads a product page (url) itself. Use it first for any new design. Example: { brief: «Instagram post for my coffee shop opening, warm minimal», headline: «Grand\nopening», date: «Sat 8 Nov · 8:00», brand: «Kava», photo: «coffee shop interior» }. Returns the design’s id and link (for the signed-in person only: to see, edit and watch your changes live; not a link to send). Counts towards the daily design limit. The person’s own picture (`file` on ChatGPT, or `image_url`, with `picture_is`) goes in instead of a stock photo. Optional `references` (visual references: a brand’s page, a pin, a shot) make it follow their style and layout with the person’s own words and photos.

brief.description: what it is for, in the person’s words; e.g. «Instagram post + story for my coffee shop opening, warm minimal»

eyebrow.description: the small line near the headline (a date, a tag)

file.description: ChatGPT fills it: the picture the person attached in this chat { download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name }; fetched once, kept with this design only

format.description: post 1080×1350 (default), story 1080×1920, square, post+story, carousel (3 slides), youtube (thumbnail), card (business card, two sides), invitation (A5), menu (price list, A4), poster; none: read from the brief

headline.description: the big line, 2–5 words (\n breaks a line); e.g. «Grand\nopening»

image_url.description: the person’s picture: an https link or a data: URL (PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ ~180 KB); one you cannot pass: upload_picture — never describe or redraw it

items.description: a menu’s or price list’s rows in order { name, price, section (the heading it goes under) }; e.g. [{ "name": "Flat white", "price": "€3.20", "section": "Coffee" }]

person.description: a person’s name (a card’s, a guest of honour’s, a quote’s author)

photo.description: IN ENGLISH, what the photo shows; e.g. «latte art on a wooden table»; none: chosen for the brief

picture_is.description: photo (fills the photo frame), product or person (cut out, in the cut-out place), logo (a corner + its colours as the brand’s); auto (default): read from the file

references.description: Optional visual references, 1–3 public https addresses, best first: the brand’s own page (its type, palette, buttons), then a pin, Behance or Dribbble shot — best the picture’s own address (i.pinimg.com…) — whose layout and look are followed closely; words, photos and logos stay the person’s own.

share.description: turns the design's share link on: ONLY when the person asked in this conversation for a link to send: «view» (anyone with it looks) or «edit» (anyone signed in edits). Ask the person first; never share on your own. Otherwise leave it out: only the owner sees the design.

slots.description: words for a template’s text slot by its name (list_styles { template } or get_design names them); e.g. [{ "slot": "Age", "text": "7" }]

style.description: a style in words, or a pack id: tolva, dayrate, northpace, oscilla, second-draft, maplebrook, ambra; e.g. «warm minimal»

template.description: a template id from list_styles (pack/slug); none: picked for the brief; e.g. «tolva/02-big-number-post»

title.description: a person’s job or a card’s tagline

url.description: a web page the person named (a product or launch page): Paletoo reads it itself — the product’s name, picture (cut out when a product shot), words and facts; e.g. "https://shop.example/serum"

name: create_design
title: Create a design
